title: Roasted Sweetcorn Salad
description: A refreshing salad perfect for a quick vegan dinner, made with roasted sweetcorn and mixed greens.
instructions: Cut the sweetcorn off the cob.
Toss the sweetcorn with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Roast the sweetcorn in the oven for 15 minutes, or until lightly browned.
In a large bowl, whisk together the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil and the hummus.
Add the mixed greens and diced salad to the bowl and toss to combine.
Top the salad with the roasted sweetcorn.
